_about: Friends of CCAIR (About page). A logo is used only as the organization publishes it on its own site, self-hosted unaltered under assets/friends/ (scaled in CSS, never recolored or cropped). An organization whose site shows no logo of its own gets a plain text wordmark (wordmark.name over wordmark.sub, in Lato, GSU Blue) instead; logo is then null.

friends.name: Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, University of Arizona
friends.description: Founded and led by Regents' Professor Hsinchun Chen in the Eller College of Management.
friends.logoNote: The lab's site (ai.arizona.edu, which redirects to the Eller page) shows only the University of Arizona and Eller College marks and a photo banner, no lab logo.

friends.name: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence Lab (DSAIL), Indiana University
friends.description: Kelley School of Business lab building data science and AI-enabled analytics for societally relevant applications.

logo.alt: DSAIL, Data Science & AI Lab, Kelley School of Business, Indiana University logo

friends.logoNote: Logo file provided by Ben Ampel (DSAIL collaborator) on 2026-10-24; used unaltered, metadata stripped.

friends.name: Collaborative Human-AI (CHAI) Center, Georgia State University
friends.description: Center of Excellence led by Georgia State with Duke University and the U.S. Army Research Laboratory.
friends.logoNote: Official CHAI logo ("CHAI Logo - GSU Blue", uploaded September 2026) from the center's own media library; used unaltered, metadata stripped.

friends.name: Center for Digital Innovation, Georgia State University
friends.description: Robinson College research center on using digital innovation to solve business and societal problems.
friends.logoNote: Official Georgia State University / J. Mack Robinson College of Business lockup with the center's unit line, from the header of the center's site. Used unaltered with its built-in clear space; metadata stripped and recompressed losslessly.
